source_binding.invariant: Every selectable ContextItem requires an exact ContextCostWitness whose payload_sha256 matches the item payload and whose measured_cost_units matches the item's declared cost_units before budget admission. The witness is measurement/admission evidence only, not truth/effect authority.

VSR01_COMPLETED_HEARD_OUTPUT_REENTRY.require: Any completed-output ContextItem admitted into the next-turn ContextView must carry an exact ContextCostWitness bound to the same payload_sha256 and measured cost. Digest/reference presence alone is insufficient.

VSR02_INTERRUPTED_HEARD_PREFIX_EPHEMERAL.require: The exact measured heard-prefix, when retained as ephemeral next-turn dialogue context, must be represented as its own payload identity and must have a ContextCostWitness for that heard-prefix payload. The unheard tail must remain excluded. A witness for the full pre-interruption output cannot authorize the shorter heard-prefix ContextItem unless payload identity is exactly equal.

negative_tests: VSR01 rejects a selectable completed-output context item with no cost witness
VSR01 rejects equal-looking reference metadata when witness payload_sha256 differs by one bit
VSR02 rejects reuse of the full-output witness when heard-prefix payload_sha256 differs
VSR02 admits the heard-prefix only when its own exact witness is supplied and confirms the unheard-tail digest is absent from selected context refs
next_exact_action: Trigger4 consumes this as an addendum to the existing VSR01-VSR06 integration handoff: refresh overlap, reuse the existing ContextCompiler/TypedMemory/GWT/reentry authorities, implement only the smallest adapter/harness delta, execute the VSR set on the proven VPS route, and require exact ContextCostWitness binding for VSR01/VSR02 before component-integration promotion.
